newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyo Radiator, Tata to make radiators in India.
newsitem.headline: Toyo Radiator, Tata to make radiators in India.

text.p: Japan's Toyo Radiator Co Ltd said on Tuesday it has agreed to establish a joint venture with India's Tata Autocomp Systems Ltd and Japanese trading house Mitsubishi Corp to make and sell radiators in India.

Tata Toyo Radiator Private Ltd, to be capitalised at about 800 million yen, will be owned 51 percent by Tata Autocomp -- a Tata Industries Ltd company, 39 percent by Toyo and 10 percent by Mitsubishi, Toyo said in a statement.
Total investment in the business will be about 1.6 billion yen, and a plant to be built in India's Maharashtra state is expected to begin operations in September 1998, Toyo said.
The venture will produce aluminium radiators for automobiles and have a production target of 300,000 radiators by 2000, a Toyo official said.
The products will be supplied to Tata Industries' unit, Tata Engineering and Locomotive Co Ltd, and Japanese car makers in India, Toyo said.

Toyo described the Indian market as having great potential and said that car makers from Japan, the United States and Europe were accelerating their entries into the country as it shifts towards freer economic policies.
